questions.question: What does Adam want to talk to Ewa about at the café?
answers: About agreeing on a child support amount without a court
questions.explanation: Adam opens: "I wanted to talk about child support... agree on an amount without a court."

questions.question: What tactic does Ewa use when she says "You are making a mountain out of a molehill"?
answers: Answering a question with a question
Changing the subject to the holidays
questions.explanation: It is downplaying — "it is only child support, everyone pays it somehow".

questions.question: What child support amount does Adam propose at the mediator's?
answers: Twelve hundred zloty plus half of the expenses for school and medical care
questions.explanation: Adam proposes 1,200 zloty a month plus half of the expenses for school and medical care.

questions.question: What does Adam do when Ewa says "And what exactly do you spend so much on?"
answers: He says they are talking about child support now and can return to the other topic later
He admits he is at fault
questions.explanation: Adam calmly returns to the topic: "But right now we are talking about child support."

questions.question: What amount do they finally agree on?
answers: Fifteen hundred plus half of the expenses for school and medical care
questions.explanation: Adam writes: "We agreed on fifteen hundred plus half of the expenses for school and medical care."
